title: Claim ready to close — all tasks done, all sections resolved
walkthroughSteps: Land on CLM-2024-001 overview — status chip reads 'In progress'

walkthroughSteps.title: All tasks done
walkthroughSteps.body: Every task on this claim is marked Done — the Tasks widget shows 0 pending.

walkthroughSteps: Sections are all resolved too — no open deductibles, salvage, litigation, reserves, payments, or provider blockers remain

walkthroughSteps.title: Close Claim
walkthroughSteps.body: With every task done and no section blockers left, Close Claim is enabled.
walkthroughSteps.expectedAfterClick: Opens the closure modal directly at Step 2 (reason selection) — the blocker checklist step is skipped because there's nothing blocking.

walkthroughSteps: In the modal, select a Closure Reason and confirm
Status chip updates to 'Closed'; closure panel appears with date, reason, and handler

acceptanceCriteria.statement: All tasks completed — Tasks widget shows 0 pending
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Every task on CLM-2024-001 is marked **Done** — the Tasks widget on the overview shows **0 pending tasks**.

All section rows show Closed status

Sections widget: all rows show Closed status
